title: Bathroom Pods
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Pod delivered undamaged with its factory QA and test pack?
Positioned and levelled to setting-out, packers solid and fully bearing?
Ask the fitter: What's your check before the pod is offered – top cleaned, coves made good, gully clear? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Drainage air test to 38 mm water gauge before final connections, no loss?
questions.source: SBE pod ITP – drainage air test

questions.q: Manifold and shower mixer pressure tested at 6 bar for 60 min?
questions.source: SBE pod ITP – water integrity test

questions.q: Towel rail earthing tested to prove RCD compliance?
Pod fixing bolts all in, tight and none missing?
Water, waste and electrics connected on site and checked for leaks?
Pod finishes undamaged and protected after connection?

notOk.t: Top of pod dirty / debris left on the roof
Shadow gaps and ceiling at light/vent coves not made good
Shower gully stone not cut straight or gully not clear
Mirror / medicine cabinet doors missing, mastic missing
Shower valve lagging incomplete, pipework not drained
White silicone proud of the face (cut back flat or transparent)
Access aperture too small / clashing with valves
Fittings missing: towel ring, shower set, handles
